sloka: स तु क्रुद्धो महावेगो महापार्श्वो महाद्युतिः।करेणैकेन जग्राह सुमहान्तं परश्वधम् ।। ६.९९.१७ ।।
transliteration: sa tu kruddho mahāvego mahāpārśvo mahādyutiḥ।kareṇaikena jagrāha sumahāntaṁ paraśvadham ।। 6.99.17 ।।

translations.english: Angry Mahaparsva, who was endowed with speed and shining brightly, took hold of an extraordinary battle axe in one hand.
